title: the same shadowing answer when the outer name is declared LAST
note: FIXED 2026-09-03 (I4). The twin of L3-inherited-shadows-outer-backward with the outer `part def W;` moved to the end. The two used to disagree — the parser bound the outer `W` when it had already been seen and the library binder bound the inherited one otherwise — so the SAME text meant two different things. Declaration order is not significant in SysML v2; both files must answer `P::Base::W`.
